question: How can sankhya and yoga be one when their names differ?
premises: what sankhya attains yoga also reaches
one who sees both sees rightly
knowing is not without yoga and yoga not without knowing
inference: sankhya and yoga are one recognition, not separate disciplines
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are analyzed as given, not split
plain_english: What sankhya attains yoga also reaches; one who sees both sees rightly, for these two are eternally connected and neither knowing nor yoga stands without the other.
